Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/1352/2021

Dear Ms. Fernandes,

Thank you for meeting us on 20/04/2022 about your dispute with Leena Mehra. As we understand it, the cheque came back with the remark account closed. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Madurai.

Our advice is to treat the closure of the account as evidence of dishonest intent and oppose any compounding below the full cheque amount. Please collect the cheque, the return memo showing the account was closed and the loan agreement and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
